input.quote: 10.2 Additional Representations and Warranties of Harpoon. Except as set forth on Schedule 10.2, Harpoon further represents and warrants to AbbVie, as of the Effective Date, as follows:
input.rationale: Article 10 contains only mutual and Harpoon-specific representations given "as of the Effective Date" (10.1, 10.2) plus covenants (10.3) — there is no forward-looking performance warranty. The closest performance standard, Section 3.8.4 ("in good scientific manner and in compliance with all Applicable Law"), is a mutual compliance covenant, not a conformance warranty, and carries no warranty remedy. Nothing in the Agreement warrants that Harpoon's deliverables (including the Final Development Report) or any software will conform to their documentation, and no repair, replacement or refund remedy exists anywhere (searches for "conform", "re-perform" and "refund" return only tax and indemnity mechanics, and all payments are expressed as non-refundable). The disclaimer at 10.5 is acceptable because it preserves "THE EXPRESS WARRANTIES SET FORTH HEREIN", so no carve-out edit is needed — but it leaves nothing to preserve. This fails the fallback on material terms (no conformance warranty, no duration, no remedy), so we inserted the shortest express warranty at fallback level: 90 days for software/deliverables, 30 days for the Initial Development Activities, with repair/replacement, re-performance or refund. We did not take the preferred 12-month software period, compliance-with-laws or malicious-code elements, which are not apposite to this development and option agreement.

ops.text: Performance Warranty. Harpoon warrants that (a) for ninety (90) days following delivery, any software and other deliverables provided by Harpoon to AbbVie hereunder, including the Final Development Report, will conform in all material respects to their documentation, and (b) for thirty (30) days following performance, the Initial Development Activities will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. For breach of this warranty, Harpoon shall, at AbbVie's election, repair or replace the non-conforming deliverable, re-perform the non-conforming activities, or refund the amounts paid for them.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article 10 gives us only as-of-Effective-Date representations, with no conformance warranty for Harpoon's deliverables or Development activities and no remedy for non-conforming work. We added a short express performance warranty at our fallback position (90 days for software and other deliverables, 30 days for the Initial Development Activities) with repair, replacement, re-performance or refund as the remedy.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 10.6 express performance warranty: 90-day conformance for software/deliverables, 30-day services warranty, with repair/replacement or refund remedy.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
